name: Agriculture Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public agriculture data.

entries.title: AMIS Market Database
entries.description: The G20 Agricultural Market Information System's database of supply-and-demand balances for wheat, maize, rice, and soybeans across the principal trading countries, letting users compare estimates from the major sources side by side.
entries.publisher: Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS), Secretariat hosted by FAO

coverage.spatial: AMIS participating countries (principal producers and traders) and world totals

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (AMIS Market Database notice; FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use, Annex 1)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (redirects to /home). The site is JavaScript-rendered; headless Chromium shows the Market Monitor, a Market Database (Supply & Demand overview, Compare sources, Custom query at https://app.amis-outlook.org/#/market-database/...) and a Policy Database. The download format is assumed from the custom-query tool and should be confirmed by a steward.
Licence checked 2026-10-31: the Supply & Demand overview (https://app.amis-outlook.org/#/market-database/supply-and-demand-overview) states "This work is made available under the Creative Commons Attribution-4.0 International license (CC BY 4.0)", and FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/) list "Agricultural Market Information Systems (AMIS) – Market database" in Annex 1. The database credits IGC and USDA-PSD as sources, and FAO's terms say third-party data may not be redistributed or reused without the original provider's consent.

entries.title: Eurostat Agriculture Database
entries.description: Eurostat's official EU agricultural statistics — farm structure and agricultural census, crop and animal production, agricultural prices and economic accounts, and agri-environmental indicators — harmonised across EU member states.

coverage.spatial: EU member states (some EFTA and candidate countries); regional (NUTS) breakdowns for some tables

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (Eurostat copyright notice and free re-use of data)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page lists the Agriculture data navigation tree, agricultural census, and agri-environmental indicators. Eurostat's copyright notice (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/help/copyright-notice) licenses its content under CC BY 4.0 and states the ESS policy of free statistics regardless of use. API and bulk access go through Eurostat's general dissemination services.
Cadence varies by table, from monthly price series to the decennial agricultural census; recorded as irregular for the collection.

entries.title: FAO AQUASTAT
entries.description: FAO's global information system on water and agriculture: country statistics on water resources, water withdrawal by sector, irrigation and drainage, and agricultural water management.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

coverage.temporal: varies by variable (five-year periods for many series)

entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. Data is served by the AQUASTAT Dissemination System at https://data.apps.fao.org/aquastat/ (HTTP 200, JavaScript-rendered). AQUASTAT is listed in Annex 1 of FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/), which licenses those databases CC BY 4.0. Download format assumed from the dissemination system; a steward should confirm.

entries.title: FAO FishStat (Fisheries and Aquaculture Statistics)
entries.description: FAO's global fishery and aquaculture statistics: capture and aquaculture production by country since 1950, aquatic trade, processed production, fishery food balance sheets and employment, distributed through the FishStatJ software workspaces and online query panels.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

coverage.spatial: global (by country and FAO fishing area)
coverage.temporal: production 1950-2024; trade and processed production 1976-2024; food balance sheets 1961-2021

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use; FishStat listed in Annex 1)
entries.attribution: FAO. [year of last update]. FishStat: [name of dataset]. [Accessed on DD Month YYYY]. [URL] Licence: CC-BY-4.0.
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200. The issue's URL https://www.fao.org/fishery/en/fishstat redirects to https://www.fao.org/fishery/fishstat/en, which is cataloged. The page says "FAO FishStat is the leading source of global fishery and aquaculture statistics" and its release calendar lists the FAO Yearbook with "statistics up to 2024" (September 2026), global employment data 1995-2024 (September 2026), and "Aquaculture, Capture and Global production databases with data from 1950 to 2024", accessible "through the global production workspace at FishStatJ and on the online query panel". FishStatJ is downloadable desktop software; the bulk method reflects that and the downloadable datasets, which I did not open, so no file formats are listed.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/) say "Unless specified otherwise in their metadata or webpage, all datasets disseminated through FAO corporate statistical databases (see examples in Annex 1) are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0)", with additional terms: no use "in conjunction with the promotion of a commercial enterprise", third-party data may carry other conditions, and a prescribed citation. Annex 1 names "Fisheries and Aquaculture (FishStat)". Per-dataset metadata was not checked for third-party exceptions; no API was checked.

entries.title: FAO Food Price Index
entries.description: FAO's monthly measure of change in international prices of a basket of food commodities: the trade-weighted average of five commodity group indices (cereals, vegetable oils, dairy, meat, sugar), in nominal and real terms.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.license: unverified — the FFPI page states no licence; FAO's CC-BY-4.0 database terms cover its corporate statistical databases, and their Annex 1 lists examples only, without naming the FFPI
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. Page lists the 2026 monthly release dates and the latest release (2 October 2026), with downloads as Excel (nominal and real indices, monthly from 1990 and annual from 1961) and CSV (nominal monthly from 1990).
Licence checked 2026-10-31: the FFPI page shows only "© FAO 2026" and FAO's general terms link. FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/) license "all datasets disseminated through FAO corporate statistical databases (see examples in Annex 1)" under CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise. Annex 1 is a list of examples, so the FFPI's absence from it does not exclude the index; but whether the FFPI counts as a corporate statistical database is not settled, so the licence stays unverified.

entries.title: FAOSTAT
entries.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's global statistical database covering agricultural production, trade, land use, and food security for nearly every country and territory.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Bulk downloads available via FAOSTAT's own bulk-download API in addition to the interactive browser. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: FEWS NET Food Security Data and Analysis
entries.description: The Famine Early Warning Systems Network's monitoring and projections of acute food insecurity: IPC-compatible food insecurity classifications by country and period, with markets and trade, agroclimatology, livelihood zone and boundary data, for the countries most at risk of famine.
entries.publisher: Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET)

access.auth_note: The FEWS NET Data Explorer (fdw.fews.net) shows a sign-in screen; the classification files on fews.net were listed without one.

coverage.spatial: about 30 monitored countries and regions in Africa, Asia, the Middle East and Latin America
coverage.temporal: varies by series (projections to May 2027 seen)

entries.license: unverified — FEWS NET's data use and attribution policy requires attribution and pass-through of the acknowledgement, but names no licence
entries.attribution: FEWS NET, with attribution as given in each dataset's metadata and a link to the FEWS NET website
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl and headless Chromium). The home page reads "Monitoring & forecasting acute food insecurity", with featured reports dated October 2026, and its footer says "The information provided on this Website is not official U.S. Government information and does not represent the views or positions of the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Government." No notice about the reported 2025 shutdown or restoration appeared on the home page, the About page or the acute food insecurity data page; the site is up and current, and the footer now names the Department of State rather than USAID. The acute food insecurity page (https://fews.net/data/acute-food-insecurity) offers "Download all acute food insecurity classification data" and lists per-country file sets such as "Cameroon Oct 2026 - May 2027 8 Files". The FEWS NET Data Explorer at https://fdw.fews.net/data-explorer/ answered with a sign-in page. jurisdiction is recorded as US because FEWS NET is a US-government-funded network, though the site disclaims official status; a steward may prefer international-ngo.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: the "Data and information use and attribution policy" (https://help.fews.net/fdp/data-and-information-use-and-attribution-policy) says "If using data provided through the FEWS NET Wesbite in any way, direct or manipulated, you must include attribution for the data you use in the manner indicated in the metadata", requires the same acknowledgement "in any sub-licenses of the data that you grant", says "You may use our application programming interfaces", and warns that third-party data (e.g. "UN COMTRADE data, cannot be disseminated in any form without written permission") carry their own terms. No named licence is given, so it is recorded as unverified. Not checked: file formats, the API, the start year of any series.

entries.title: USDA Census of Agriculture
entries.description: A complete count of U.S. farms and ranches and the people who operate them, taken every five years, covering land use and ownership, operator characteristics, production practices, income, and expenditures down to the county level.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Statistics Service (USDA NASS)

coverage.spatial: United States, states, counties, and outlying areas
coverage.temporal: 1840-present (2002 and prior in the archived reports)

entries.attribution: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Census of Agriculture
entries.notes:
The AgCensus landing page sits behind an Azure WAF JavaScript challenge: a plain curl got HTTP 403, though scripts/check_links.py reported it ok (HTTP 200) the same day. If the probe later reports blocked, that is bot protection, not a dead link. Human-verified 2026-10-31 in headless Chromium (HTTP 200, page text confirms "taken only once every five years" and the 2022 Census). The 2022 publication index, https://www.nass.usda.gov/Publications/AgCensus/2022/index.php, answers curl with HTTP 200. Table-level data is also reachable through the Census Data Query Tool and Quick Stats.
Cadence is quinquennial (every five years; most recent 2022). The schema has no five-year value, so it is recorded as irregular.

entries.title: USDA ERS Farm Income and Wealth Statistics
entries.description: The Economic Research Service's official U.S. and state-level estimates of farm sector income, assets, debt, and wealth, plus U.S.-level forecasts for the current calendar year.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (USDA ERS)
entries.attribution: USDA Economic Research Service, Farm Income and Wealth Statistics
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (the trailing-slash URL redirects to the slashless form). Page shows "Updated: 9/3/2026" and states the three-releases-per-year schedule.
Released three times a year (early February, late August/early September, late November/early December). The schema has no such value, so it is recorded as irregular.

entries.title: USDA FAS Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD Online)
entries.description: USDA's official country-by-country estimates and forecasts of production, consumption, trade, and stocks for major agricultural commodities worldwide — the data behind the monthly WASDE and World Agricultural Production reports.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service (USDA FAS)

coverage.temporal: varies by commodity (decades of marketing years)

entries.attribution: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Production, Supply and Distribution database
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: app loads (HTTP 200); the Reports and Data view lists zipped CSV bulk downloads (e.g. https://apps.fas.usda.gov/psdonline/downloads/psd_alldata_csv.zip) and the release schedule. A US agency's estimates of global production, so jurisdiction is national (US) even though coverage is global.

entries.title: USDA NASS Quick Stats
entries.description: The National Agricultural Statistics Service's online database of official published aggregate estimates for U.S. agricultural production — crops, livestock, prices, demographics, and economics — at national, state, and county level, including Census of Agriculture results.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Statistics Service (USDA NASS)

access.auth_note: Web query tool is open; the Quick Stats API requires a free API key requested from the site.
access.rate_limit: API returns at most 50,000 records per request (documented on the API page).

coverage.spatial: United States (national, state, county; some sub-state districts)
coverage.temporal: varies by series (historical series back to the 1800s for some commodities)

entries.attribution: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Quick Stats
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: site and API documentation page load (HTTP 200 via curl). API page documents the free key and the 50,000-record limit per call.
Updated as each NASS report is released, so cadence is recorded as event.

entries.title: USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey
entries.description: The National Cooperative Soil Survey's authoritative soil maps and soil property data for most U.S. counties, delivered through an interactive area-of-interest tool with downloadable SSURGO soil survey data.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Natural Resources Conservation Service (USDA NRCS)

coverage.temporal: current published soil survey data (refreshed annually)

entries.attribution: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service, Web Soil Survey
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200; the root redirects to https://websoilsurvey.nrcs.usda.gov/app/. The NRCS SSURGO page (www.nrcs.usda.gov) timed out to curl this session, so this entry points at the Web Soil Survey delivery tool, not that description page.

entries.title: USDA SNAP Data Tables
entries.description: Participation and benefit statistics for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the largest US food-assistance program: national annual summaries since 1969, and monthly state-level persons, households and benefits, with project-area/county data and Pandemic EBT tables.
entries.publisher: USDA Food and Nutrition Administration (formerly Food and Nutrition Service)

coverage.spatial: United States (national, state, and project area/county for bi-annual data)
coverage.temporal: FY1969 to present (latest month July 2026 when checked)

entries.license: public-domain (US Gov work; USDA site policy says most information is public domain, byline credit requested)
entries.attribution: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Administration, SNAP Data Tables
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 via curl with a browser User-Agent. The issue's URL https://www.fns.usda.gov/pd/supplemental-nutrition-assistance-program-snap answers an Akamai 301 to www.fna.usda.gov, so the final URL is cataloged; the page title is "SNAP Data Tables | Food and Nutrition Administration" (the agency name now reads Food and Nutrition Administration). The page lists "Annual Summary Participation and Costs, 1969-2025" (PDF, Excel), a zip of persons, households and benefits "FY 69 through FY 26", state-level participation and benefits for the "Latest Available Month - July 2026", P-EBT tables FY20-26, and bi-annual project area/county data "FY 89 through July 2025". "Page updated: October 20, 2026". Headless Chromium got an Akamai "Access Denied" (403) on both the fns and fna hosts, while plain curl with a browser User-Agent got 200, so a link checker may see either.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: the USDA "Policies and Links" page (www.usda.gov/about-usda/policies-and-links returned 403 to curl, Chromium and WebFetch; read from USDA's own mirror host https://usda.azureedge.us/about-usda/policies-and-links) says "Most information presented on the USDA Web site is considered public domain information. Public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, but use of appropriate byline/photo/image credits is requested. Attribution may be cited as follows: 'U.S. Department of Agriculture.'" It also says some materials are protected by copyright, trademark or patent. No data-specific licence was found on the SNAP page. Cadence is monthly for the state tables; the annual summary is yearly. Not checked: the content of the spreadsheets, or the linked dashboards.
